notes: Calories-only chain; the PDF is one image with no text layer, so it was read by OCR. The script's figures needed Tesseract at 250, 300 and 350 dpi to agree on every one of the 19 rows (they did). Independent check: I read the 16 menu rows' kcal by eye on 450 dpi crops (749, 1159, 456, 948, 269, 679, 605, 409, 741, 314, 523, 821, 725, 492, 792, 679) and the pizzas 1437 and 1796 on 450 dpi crops, and 1742 on the 100 dpi page view (also read by OCR at six resolutions): 19 of 19 match the CSV; the triage notes had 469 for the Bacon Filled Roll and 1746 for the BBQ pizza, and the page shows 409 and 1796 (the menu's slashed zero is what misleads OCR at some resolutions: 200 dpi read 499 and 159, 450 dpi read 4099). Icons read by eye: halal on Chicken Goujon Burger and Chicken Strips (3) and (5); vegetarian on French Fries and the 4 Cheese Pizza (tagged vegetarian). One anomaly copied as printed: the '& Fries' dishes add about 410 kcal (749 to 1159, 269 to 679) but Chicken Goujon Burger & Fries adds 492 (456 to 948). Six club pages (Glasgow South, Birmingham Perry Barr, Coventry, Leicester, Northampton, Chester) each link this Food Menu; none lists what that club stocks.
